chunks: Whereupon Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said: That is the most praiseworthy way of (losing) them.
ai.seo_question: What is the most praiseworthy way of losing camels according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this concise utterance from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies 'Ahmad' (often interpreted as the most praiseworthy or the Prophet Muhammad himself) as the definitive path or 'door' to success. This statement underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on following the exemplary conduct of the Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate means to fulfill religious and worldly obligations, such as the careful management of camels in this specific context.
